verdict.rationale: YYLO gives agents isolation at the Git and filesystem level, not a security sandbox. `task start` creates a dedicated branch/worktree and runs configured dependency hydration before work begins, and benchmark candidates run in private fresh repositories rather than shared worktrees. Nothing in the evidence shows process, container or network isolation that would make running arbitrary code or installing dependencies safe. Missing for 10: OS/container-level sandboxing of agent code execution, restrictions on network or host access during dependency installs, and independent or hands-on corroboration of isolation guarantees.
